integrity: Explicit rooted dual-coordinate normalization; the product is coordinate invariant. First-public-date anchor is the 2018-10-26 arXiv posting of Aliaga–Pernecká, primary 46B20. Primary scientific proof is self-contained and numerical triangulations are corroborative.
scientific_limitations: Finite real Lipschitz-free spaces over single weighted cycles only. The two exact volume sums may be exponentially long. Eleven rational examples corroborate but do not prove the general theorem; bibliographic overlap remains possible. No general Mahler conjecture resolved.
title: Exact Mahler volumes of arbitrary weighted-cycle Lipschitz-free spaces
